features: Professionally Tested and Quality Checked: This mini PC is powered by an i3 8th Generation processor with 8GB RAM, tested for dependable performance in daily office, study and home use
Fast SSD Storage with Expansion Support: The 256GB SSD reduces boot times and speeds up application loading, while memory and storage can be upgraded later, subject to hardware compatibility
Multiple Connectivity Options: USB 3.0, HDMI, DisplayPort, Ethernet LAN, WiFi and Bluetooth let you connect monitors, keyboards, printers, speakers and other peripherals for a complete setup
Compact Space-Saving Design: The micro-sized body fits neatly on desks or behind monitors, keeping workspaces clean and organised while consuming less power than traditional desktop towers
Ready to Work Out of the Box: Suited to home offices, study desks, reception counters and billing desks; monitor, keyboard and mouse not included, backed by a 6 month warranty from EPW India Limited
Built for Home, Office and Study: Handles documents, online meetings, web browsing, billing applications and school work in a small footprint that fits living rooms, study corners and office desks
